items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: We just picked it up and picked up the best men that we knew that could compare with the men that had dropped out. We just renewed the name and went on out again.

ctx.x: The date is September the 23rd, I believe, 22nd or 23rd, anyway, 1961. There's the calendar over that. And this is Bill Russell and Ralph Collins, interviewing Mr. Robertson. Do you mind giving your full name, Mr. Robertson? Henry Robertson. Henry, any middle name?
You were saying about this, the young Excelsior.

Yeah, the young Excelsior. You see, they had the old Excelsior. Well, so many of the old fellas died out. Well, then lots of them come and say, you know, they'd kill about picking. It'd take like me and several more others who wasn't going to let it go down. We just picked it up and picked up the best men that we knew that could compare with the men that had dropped out. We just renewed the name and went on out again.
